app_tagline:
BI AQYL is an AI assistant for working with knowledge.
It takes your sources (documents, sites, video) and turns them into an interactive knowledge base.
login_copy: Sign in with your BI Group corporate email — materials, cards, and history open in one place.
login_hint: The MVP uses a lightweight sign-in flow, and the BI Group domain is appended automatically.
login_stage_title: Upload documents and videos — AI turns them into a knowledge base
login_stage_copy: No need to read everything. Upload a file, get a card with the key points, ask a question, get an answer.
feature_one_copy: PDF, Word, audio, video — everything is processed automatically.
feature_two_copy: AI extracts the key points and shows you where they came from.
feature_three_copy: If the card doesn’t answer — ask directly, AI will find the answer in your documents.
materials_copy: Cases, lectures, notes. All cases are shown as a list.
studio_note_copy: Add sources first, then generate notes, podcasts, or infographics from them.
empty_copy: Try a different query or clear the filters.
empty_fresh_copy: Upload your first material — a document, article, or video.
advisor_placeholder: Describe your business situation or ask a question...
